name: genpark-personal-agent-sub-maximal-treadmill-vvo2max-running-economy-skill
title: Sub-Maximal Treadmill Running Economy & vVO2max Skill
description: Sub-maximal running economy oxygen cost (ml O2/kg/km), velocity at VO2max (vVO2max), and marathon finishing time prediction. Built for GenPark (https://www.genpark.ai).

tools.name: calculate_running_economy_and_vvo2max
tools.description: Compute running economy and velocity at VO2 max (vVO2max km/h) from treadmill oxygen uptake telemetry.

tools.name: predict_marathon_finish_time
tools.description: Predict marathon finish time based on vVO2max and fractional aerobic utilization (80-85%).
